candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order /v1/orders returns HTTP 500. Traces and logs show each checkout 502 paired with an order 500 within the same correlation ID, and the gateway's own /readyz stays 200, localizing the fault to the order service.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db-pool, redis, payment) not observable from gateway evidence; only the 500 propagation is established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently caused by order service 500s: traces pair each checkout 502 with an order /v1/orders 500 under the same correlation ID, logs show http_client_request 500 to order, and gateway health endpoints remain 200. The bounded cause is the order-service 500 propagating as a gateway 502.
